beats.label: Thieves' Den telescope sky (no exit)
beats.stage_hook: mission_controller.toggle_telescope_ponder(); the mission's _ponder_cam; never toggled back (L4-13 exit strands the player)

beats.label: Den props, decals & gramophone
beats.reason: Multi-subject beat: decoration swap (DenDecorationPedestal.interact), boot-trail decal crossing, gramophone ON (gram area -> AudioManager.toggle_gramophone), trunk-treasure cycling, then a walk to the map table. The two interact hooks exist, but there is no camera/pan driver for the sequence; a single prop frame would misrepresent the beat. Deferred to a v2 lane, not faked.

beats.label: Mission preparation
beats.stage_hook: mission_prep_ui.gd instantiate + open_prep('guildhall', 1, 'Solo', 2, true) (free play: Contract Inactive)

beats.label: Briefing letter
beats.stage_hook: mission.tscn free play Mission.Guildhall.LootTheRoom on contract_order=2 map=guildhall; hud.is_mission_letter_open() (GameState.request_mission_letter -> hud.show_mission_letter)

beats.label: Guildhall safe-room HUD / lantern / portal
beats.stage_hook: safe_room_dressing.gd (mission_controller._add_guildhall_saferoom_dressing) + SafeRoomLanternStation.set_lit(true, false) + authored TATSafeRoomPlayerStart_0 pose

beats.label: Street / alley approach, vintage car & gate alert
beats.reason: Needs a continuous movement driver from the safe-room catwalk to the alley: vault, wet-cobble sprint, crouch, and the car [F] INTERACT at the wrought-iron gate. No multi-beat input driver exists. The authored BARRON'S DEMOLITION banner asset is also absent (HARD_LIMIT, docs/reports/p1-integration-20261126.md).

beats.label: ZipWire [1] equip, gate headlights, 1st launch
beats.reason: Requires [1] equip, gate aim, the 1st zipwire launch and a planter landing. The zipwire traversal has no stable still-stage hook without an input driver.

beats.label: 2nd ZipWire launch & crank ascent
beats.reason: Requires the 2nd zipwire shot plus ~7 s of crank input ([HOLD] CRANK) to the roof ridge; depends on S14 state and a continuous driver.

beats.label: Roofline traversal & 3rd ZipWire
beats.reason: Roofline/chimney traversal and the 3rd zipwire to the gate pillar; depends on S14/S15 state and has no input driver. The reference table links no keyframe to S16.

beats.label: Gate pillar gear plate & courtyard descent
beats.reason: Cable crossing, gear-plate landing and the courtyard drop that takes authored fall damage; cannot be staged without the prior zipwire state and physics-driven traversal.

beats.label: Smoke bomb [2] throw & plume
beats.reason: Needs the throw input and the plume VFX; Niagara is a labelled procedural stand-in (HL-1, docs/REFERENCE_BASELINE.md). No input driver.

beats.label: Vistara Diamond [4] scan pulse
beats.reason: Requires a live guard at the portico steps plus the [4] scan input (RED->GREEN silhouette). The staged route has no NPC in view: 4 guards + 3 civilians spawn at 48–151 m (C4-08/L4-08).

beats.label: Side wing, MACLEOD sign & terrace patrol
beats.reason: A ~21 s balcony/terrace traversal with a patrol guard; no continuous driver and no NPC on the staged route.

beats.label: Arched portico, blue double doors & scaffolding
beats.reason: Needs the approach plus [F] OPEN / [HOLD] LOCK on the blue double doors and a walk-through. The door content is proven by the P1 probes, but the staged runner cannot drive the approach.

beats.label: Fireplace parlor stealth & pickpocket
beats.reason: Requires a live constable, a crouch approach and the [F] PICK POCKET hold; no NPC on the staged route and no input driver.

beats.label: Guard takedown
beats.reason: Requires the S22 guard and the [HOLD] TAKEDOWN lunge camera. The rig was repaired, but a takedown needs a live guard and input; it is not stageable as a still.

beats.label: Foyer approach & sweeping security beams
beats.stage_hook: mission.tscn map=guildhall; live KF27 foyer poses: upper_foyer + yaw180 (p0b foyer slots) + foyer_beam at the authored C_107 beam card cue; player camera, camera_source=player

beats.label: Beam trigger, purple ward, green arcane lock
beats.reason: Requires the player to walk through the foreground beam so the authored signal seals the ward and vine lock. The lockdown hooks exist (_spawn_foyer_lockdown, security_beam.beam_triggered), but firing them directly would be a faked played beat; deferred.

beats.label: Crimson alarm spotlight & slate-stair ascent
beats.reason: Depends on S25 (breaking a barrier triggers the crimson alarm) and a stair traversal to the upper landing; no input driver.

beats.label: Pause menu
beats.stage_hook: hud.toggle_pause() over the loaded Guildhall mission; the audio tap is switched to PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS before the pause so marks keep draining

notes: This is a STAGED/MIXED capture, not a played route. route_claim=none.
13 of the 27 official beats are PLANNED to be staged through live UI/API hooks; 14 are deferred with an explicit reason. No beat is claimed as reached in a played run.
Official S01..S27 times and keyframes are provenance anchors from KEYFRAME_INDEX.md §2 (mirrored in p0b_audio_stats.py); the run does not align to them.
Staged frames use the audio tap's generic mark() only; the S01..S27 beat-marker entry point is never called, so a staged frame cannot claim a played-beat alignment.

The Den stage is contract 1 (no free play). The Guildhall stage is a STAGED SUBSTITUTE: free play Mission.Guildhall.LootTheRoom on contract 2, used only to show the KF13 briefing letter over the live safe room. It is not the official mission selection (canonical contract-2 row: Mission.Guildhall.VaultHeist; historical 2026-11-24 baseline: LootTheRoom, free_play=false). The 120-row scorer must not treat it as official.
S05 enters the telescope view and never exits: the [F] EXIT path is L4-13 (player stranded on the Den roof).
S03 uses a synthetic camera (camera_source=synthetic); S12/S24 and the Lounge extra use the player camera (camera_source=player) at the authored eye/target.
S24 is the foyer only: upper_foyer + yaw180 + foyer_beam (KF27 cue aimed at the authored C_107 card). The p0b beam_close pose is the Lounge C_57 card and is recorded in extras[0], never as S24.
TAT2_PARITY_ONLY=1 is exported by the wrapper for every mode, so expansion content is excluded from the staged run.
Under a headless/Dummy audio driver the tap records enabled=false with a reason; that is not an audio measurement.
A later lane maps these 27 rows onto docs/reference/clip_1795033698901/COMPARISON_PORT_20261124.md; this runner does not score the 120 rows.
